nom: Estée Lauder Advanced Night Cleansing Balm with Lipid Rich Oil-Infusion

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin (including oily turning combination with age) say the balm removes makeup and sunscreen thoroughly without leaving a greasy or oily residue.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it cleanses without stripping or over-drying, though one with dry skin found it fairly drying when used without a follow-up cleanse.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including a T-zone that dries out in winter, describe skin left soft, plump and not stripped.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive (including sensitive eyes, rosacea, and one with prurigo nodularis) report no stinging, irritation or breakouts, and some specify it is the only cleanser that doesn't bother their skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing their skin as aging or older (60s–70s) report softness, plumping and moisture with regular use.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes her skin as feeling 'normal,' soft and plump after use, not dry or stripped.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature/aging skin report increased softness, plumping and moisture; none report anti-aging results beyond hydration and texture.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the balm leaves skin soft, hydrated and not stripped; one with dry skin found it drying when not followed by a moisturizing second cleanse.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea/sensitive skin reports no stinging or tightness and smooth results; another mentions the product helped with redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no irritation, stinging or tightness, and some note it is the only cleanser that doesn't compromise their skin, though one notes eyes felt briefly blurry if too much product was used.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports some lightening of brown spots and brighter complexion after about a week of nightly use; this is not echoed elsewhere.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including one with cystic acne, report no new breakouts and one credits it with stopping ongoing breakouts; one reviewer used it to help clear blackheads/sebaceous filaments on the nose.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say the balm rinses clean without leaving an oily or greasy film, though a couple mention needing to wash again afterward to fully feel clean, especially around the nose.

aspects.libelle: Leaves residue or film needing rewash
Cheap plastic packaging vs line's glass jars

extraits.texte: I usually love Estee Lauder products, but this was a complete let down. I used so much of the product and none of my makeup came off. I had to use another product to get it off.

extraits.titre: Didn't know how much I needed this!
extraits.texte: I'm into the Korean 10 step skincare routine so I purchased this cleansing balm as the first step, even though it's targeted for makeup removal. I do not wear any makeup so I cannot attest how easily your makeup will melt, but I can tell you it completely removes my sunscreen & all gunk from my face! Not only does it make my skin sooo soft but it hasn't given me any breakouts. I suffer from cystic acne and have to be very careful with anything I put on my face. Only a small amount is needed and I never feel oily. One star off because it does breakdown my eyelash extensions.

This product does well for a first oil-based cleanse to help work out sebaceous filaments and blackheads. I absolutely recommend following up with the Geleé or a foaming cleanser like in the Korean double cleansing method. It was fairly drying to my admittedly dry skin after rinsing without the moisturizing Geleé cleanse. The most heartbreaking aspect of this product though is the sad, cheap plastic packaging. Why!?? The rest of the Advanced Night line has such gorgeous, luxurious glass containers.

I've been using Estee Lauder since I was 18, I'm now 69….. love all their products and this is one that I cannot do without! My skin is very sensitive and dry. It takes a small amount to cleanse. Sometimes I let it sit on my face for 5-10 minutes before removing. For my dry skin, it's so much better than a soap-based cleanser.

I love this micro cleansing balm, it is hassles free, mess free for me personally and so easy to apply as well as remove. I tell ya, I have caked on make up sometimes, layers of foundation, powder, bronze high lighter for my cheeks and blush. Just apply the balm to my face at first felt like, will this really work? It did, it just wiped all off, using my wash cloth and following online directions of how to use this. No residue, my face felt soft and fresh. Good news was next day, no breaks outs and no feeling oily residue on my face from the balm. I did apply a Estee Lauder moisturizer to follow the balm to help prevent breakouts for my dry to oily combination skin. I have very sensitive skin and I have to make sure to clean my face daily especially after wearing make up. Even on the days that I do not have cakes on make up, wither I use a powder on my face with blush and no foundation, this balm takes it right off. I do not think I can ever go back to doing things the old way ever again. This micro balm has spoiled me.

For several months I was getting breakouts. I decided that the correct cleanser was what was needed. After starting with this I have not had the breakout problem. It smells great especially in the evening because of the lavender. Physical sunscreen is the best (EL Perfectionist is a good one) and this takes it off, and most makeup needs something like this. I use some Perfectly Clean foam purifying cleanser after the balm. In the A.M. I use just a little Perfectly Clean foam purifying cleanser in the t-zone.

This is the most expensive cleansing balm I own and its honestly worth the price. It feels luxurious and almost creamy. Melts immediately and doesnt require a lot of rubbing at all. Removes all makeup including waterproof mascara. I have very dry, sensitive skin and this doesnt irritate me at all. A little goes a long way and if I use too much it can make my eyes slightly blurry for a few minutes.
